entry.title: Road Snowfall Warning
entry.summary: Snow showers may affect the Road for a time Friday morning. 1 cm may accumulate about the higher parts of the road, with lesser amounts down to 800 metres.

entry.title: Strong Wind Watch
entry.summary: Westerly winds are expected to strengthen from late this morning and may approach severe gale in exposed places, most likely this afternoon. Chance of upgrading to a Warning: Moderate.

author.name: Meteorological Service of New Zealand Limited

entry.title: Strong Wind Watch
entry.summary: Southwest winds may approach severe gale in exposed places. Chance of upgrading to a Warning: Moderate.

author.name: Meteorological Service of New Zealand Limited

entry.title: Road Snowfall Warning
entry.summary: Snow showers may affect the road at times until this evening, but little, if any snow is expected to accumulate on the road. Less than 1cm may accumulate on the road above 600 metres.
